row.title: Unlearn is judged on its own feeds
row.body: progress.json's Unlearn row read ultrastable.io's feed and healed with ci.yml, which ships nothing. It now reads unlearn.ultrastable.org/feed.xml, heals with vendor-sync.yml then ci.yml, and declares a stickiness block on the new JSON Feed (ultrastable/unlearn#2).
